subject: Initial load validation & action plan — ClearPay onboarding
messages:
From: Alex Martinez <alex@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Huang <claire@clearpay.ai>, Samir Patel <samir@clearpay.ai>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-30T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Initial load validation & action plan — ClearPay onboarding

Hi Claire / Samir,

Thanks again for the kickoff yesterday — excited to get ClearPay onto Redwood. Per our onboarding checklist, we've scoped a focused acceptance run to validate latency & throughput under representative traffic before we flip production traffic. High level targets we'd like to validate: 

- Latency: p50 < 120ms, p95 < 350ms for 512-token responses (text-generation endpoint)
- Throughput: sustained 200 rps (requests/sec) with peak bursts to 350 rps for up to 5m
- Concurrent sessions: 150 concurrent users with KV cache warm-up behavior captured
- Error rate: <0.2% server errors and successful model fallbacks tested

Planned tests and responsibilities:
- Redwood (Grace / Dev): run k6-based load script from our staging cluster, collect token-level latency, GPU utilization, and tracing hooks. We'll provide the script and a dashboard.
- ClearPay (Claire / Samir): provide a short anonymized sample corpus (<= 5k prompts) and a staging API key / test account we can target. Also confirm any PII constraints for test data.
- Timeline: baseline run tomorrow (2026-10-01), tuned run the next day, results shared and handshake by EOD 2026-10-02.

Attachments: k6_load_script.js (stub), a short example of the request payload we plan to use.

Please confirm the test window and whether you can share the sample corpus + staging key. If anything above looks off, flag it and we'll adapt.

— Alex
Alex Martinez
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
[attachment: k6_load_script.js (text)]

From: Claire Huang <claire@clearpay.ai>
To: Alex Martinez <alex@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir@clearpay.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-30T10:01:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Initial load validation & action plan — ClearPay onboarding

Thanks, Alex — this looks good.

We can provide an anonymized set of ~3,200 prompts (customer support queries) and a staging key by EOD today. A couple of notes:
- We need a short exception if any raw customer IDs are present — we will sanitize but please confirm Redwood will not store raw identifiers.
- Are you able to simulate our typical traffic mix? ~60% short queries (<= 64 tokens), 30% medium (~300 tokens), 10% long (~1024 tokens).

If you can include those ratios in the k6 workload that would be ideal. We'll also loop in security if you need SOC2 artifacts.

Claire
Claire Huang
Head of Integrations, ClearPay
[attachment: clearpay_sample_anon.csv (csv)]

From: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Huang <claire@clearpay.ai>, Samir Patel <samir@clearpay.ai>, Alex Martinez <alex@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-01T07:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Initial load validation & action plan — ClearPay onboarding

Claire — thanks for the quick turnaround. We'll honor the data handling constraints (no raw IDs stored) and will only record token counts, latencies, and anonymized request hashes in our logs.

I've adapted the k6 script to reflect the traffic mix you listed. Link to the script & dashboard below:
- k6 script: https://drive.google.com/drive/fake-link-clearpay-k6
- Live dashboard: https://dash.redwood.ai/r/clearpay-staging

Planned execution windows (PST):
1) Baseline run: 2026-10-01 10:00–10:30 (gradual ramp to 75 rps)
2) Stress run: 2026-10-01 14:00–14:45 (ramp to 350 rps bursts, sustained segments at 220 rps)
3) Tuned run + KV warm-up: 2026-10-02 09:00–09:30

I'll run the baseline and stress runs from our staging GPUs and capture model fallbacks and any OOM events. We'll also collect per-token cost estimates for the run and attach a short report.

— Grace
Grace O'Connor
Onboarding Lead, Redwood Inference
[attachment: redwood_test_report.pdf (pdf)]

From: Samir Patel <samir@clearpay.ai>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.ai>, Alex Martinez <alex@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-01T09:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Initial load validation & action plan — ClearPay onboarding

Thanks Grace — a couple quick questions from our side:
1) For the stress run, will traces include any customer-identifying strings? We need traces redacted before they leave our environment.
2) Can you show expected GPU instance sizes you plan to run (e.g., A100 80GB / H100) so our infra team can validate network egress and sizing?

We can confirm staging key by 11:00 PST. We'll push the sample CSV to the shared drive (see attachment).

— Samir
Samir Patel
Lead DevOps, ClearPay
[attachment: clearpay_sample_anon.csv (csv)]

From: Alex Martinez <alex@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Huang <claire@clearpay.ai>, Samir Patel <samir@clearpay.ai>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-02T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Initial load validation & action plan — ClearPay onboarding

Folks — quick summary of results from today's tuned run (see attached CSV with raw aggregates):

- Baseline run (10/01 10:00): p50=95ms, p95=310ms, avg tokens/req=280, error rate=0.03%
- Stress run (10/01 14:00): sustained 220 rps for 20m, peak 360 rps bursts; p95 rose to 420ms during peaks but dropped to 340ms after autoscaler added a node. We observed a single model fallback (fallback to smaller quantized variant) at 14:22 for ~90s — no client-visible 5xxs.
- Tuned run (10/02 09:00): with KV warm-up and adjusted batching, p95=330ms under 200 rps sustained, GPU utilization ~72% (A100-80GB), memory headroom ~18%.

Attachments: load_results_summary.csv (aggregates) and our short test report (redwood_test_report.pdf).

Next steps proposed:
- Dev to provide a canary rollout plan (10% traffic for 24h) and monitoring thresholds.
- Redwood to provide tightened autoscaling min/max to avoid short p95 spikes during bursts.
- ClearPay security to confirm trace redaction process (Grace noted we only keep anonymized request hashes).

Appreciate the quick collaboration — happy to walk through the results on a short call.

— Alex
Alex Martinez
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
[attachment: load_results_summary.csv (csv)]

From: Dev Patel <dev@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Huang <claire@clearpay.ai>, Samir Patel <samir@clearpay.ai>, Alex Martinez <alex@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-02T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Initial load validation & action plan — ClearPay onboarding

Nice results — quick ops plan from my side: 
- Canary: start with 10% traffic for 24h (route by header), alert if p95 > 400ms for >10m or error rate >0.3%.
- Autoscale changes: lower scale-in cooldown to 90s, enable burst nodes with a higher cost tier for 5m windows to absorb spikes.
- Follow-up: I'll share a short runbook and a preflight checklist for your infra team by tomorrow.

If you'd like, I can schedule the canary for 2026-10-05 08:00 PST.

Thanks,
Dev Patel
Senior SRE, Redwood Inference
[attachment: runbook_preflight.md (text)]
